verdict.rationale: Sill's evidence covers interactive input (touch, trackpad, keyboard, Pencil) and adaptive quality when the link falls behind. Nothing documents hardware encoding or the stream's latency, so the evidence does not show the stream itself is fast enough for interactive work. The input features and quality controls are adjacent features, not evidence for this story.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing
